description: Zodiac crystal constellation orb icons for collection grid display

styleGuide.description: Translucent magical spheres with constellation patterns glowing inside. Each zodiac sign has its distinct constellation visible within a crystalline orb.

elements.orb: Translucent crystal sphere with subtle glass-like reflections
elements.constellation: Connected star pattern specific to each zodiac sign glowing within
elements.glow: Element-appropriate color aura emanating from the orb
elements.stars: Bright points for major stars in each constellation
